XEB_fidelity_computation.note: Ideal probabilities provided in input data, no need for on-the-fly simulation

counts_files.format: JSON with bitstring keys and integer counts
counts_files.parsing: Tuple-string format converted to simple bitstring

amplitudes_files.format: JSON with bitstring keys and complex amplitude strings

limitations.subset_verification: Only ~20 bitstrings matched per instance, not full 2^N distribution
limitations.systematic_uncertainties: Bootstrap captures statistical error only, not calibration drift or amplitude computation errors
limitations.negative_fidelities: Can occur due to statistical fluctuations when true fidelity is near zero
